Initial plugin release!
Mount tilt is a plugin that allows you to apply a multiplier to your mount tilt angle and speed when in motion so you can restore the pre nerf tilt and go even further beyond!

variant.name: Mount Tilt
variant.punchline: A simple plugin that allows you to adjust your mount tilt.
